title: The Words — Sc099: Darwin's about-to-explode rant (two-shot on white)

source.github: mhvnsnt/cn-gigaleak-gumball, draft release untagged-1676e192ae8c72e95791, asset id 640772406
source.method: FLA (XFL zip) read via sequential local-header parser (2012 Flash zips have malformed central directory); DOMDocument.xml + LIBRARY symbol XMLs parsed directly. Same neutral per-keyframe transform format as production/dance-choreo v1: a part pose is (item, first_frame, affine matrix a/b/c/d/tx/ty, pivot). keyMode 9728 = pose-to-pose; sampled_frames hold each keyframe's elements to the next keyframe, matching SWF playback.

teaches: Dialogue two-shot construction: one scene layer per character (GUMBALL / DARWIN) over a WHITE layer and background, so each performance can be retimed independently. Uses an episode-specific costume head comp ('DRWAboutToExplode') swapped onto the standard Darwin puppet for one story beat.
notes: Scene layers are literally named per character: GUMBALL, DARWIN, WHITE, background.
The exploding-head variant is a separate library symbol (628 keyframes) — special story states get their own comp instead of redrawing the stock head.
Mouth comps for both characters run 360-433 keyframes: lip sync is its own pass on its own timeline.
